sloka: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नास्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।मनस्सङ्कल्पसंपाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः ।। ५.३९.३५।।।।
transliteration: tasya vikramasampannāssattvavanto mahābalāḥ ।manassaṅkalpasaṁpātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ ।। 5.39.35।।।।

translations.english: "Valiant, virtuous and powerful vanaras who can leap with the speed of mind are awaiting orders (of Sugriva).
